snippet.title: Realm of Ink PC and Console Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Realm of Ink will be launching globally on 26 May 2026 across PC (Steam), Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch.

Realm of Ink is an Ink-style action roguelike game. While pursuing the Fox Demon, the swordswoman Red, unexpectedly finds that her life is dictated by the 'destiny' within the world of the book. Only by breaking free can she unveil the truth of her existence and challenge the constraints of fate.

Do stay tuned for more information on the BlazBlue collaboration character.
